BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


       SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing all of
the Planned Development No. 1293 district symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 1-F in the area described as follows:

      West Randolph Street; North Franklin Street; West Washington Street; a line
      160.80 west of and parallel to North Franklin Street; the public alley next south of
      and parallel to West Randolph Street; and a line 120.56 east of and parallel to
      North Wacker Drive.

to the designation of DC-3 Downtown Core District.


      SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.
